uses.wording: Last Mile Platform
Last Mile builds on that foundation—connecting your existing systems, preserving the context your team relies on, and making operational information easier to use.

Last Mile consumes configured outputs from existing OT, data, work, facilities, and service platforms. It preserves their identities and responsibilities while creating one condition-to-outcome thread across them.
See what needs attention, organize the response, and check the result.
Your team can assign work, automate approved tasks, and check that the equipment is working as expected afterward.
We have developed a structured method to keep your teams in command and control of your complex operations.  We call it the Accountable Operations Loop.
See who is responding, what has changed, and whether the equipment is performing as expected.

When the field task or work order closes, Infinit-Flow asks Singularity to evaluate the configured return measurements. Work-system state is contextual evidence only; it cannot set the physical result.
Stale, quarantined, unresolved, or missing inputs are shown as No valid data and cannot support a recovered result.
Recovery requires Running status, 17.5–20.5 A motor current, 9.0–15.0 psid pressure, temperature in range, and a complete 15-minute stability window.
Pumping capacity restored over three complete wet-well cycles with zero overflow.
Infinit-Signal qualifies return evidence; Singularity establishes the canonical Outcome from flow, pressure, power, specific power, and stability; Infinit-Control presents the live state.
Refrigeration and product-protection criteria recover across pull-down, defrost, and the 45-minute stability window.
Connect equipment information, understand what needs attention, coordinate the response, and check the result with fresh operating data.
After the action, check the operating evidence. The result should be visible in the equipment’s performance, with a clear record of the response that led there.
Infinit-Signal brings information from your existing equipment and systems into Last Mile, checks its quality, and preserves where it came from.
Infinit-Signal brings that information together, checks it for problems, and prepares it for use across Last Mile.
Last Mile consumes configured source outputs and does not replace the broker or claim ownership of the customer's namespace.
The Standardized Semantic Object Model defines portable operational meaning, identity, relationships, temporal semantics, quality, evidence, provenance, conformance, and profiles.

Singularity creates the operational world model connecting assets, processes, observations, Conditions, evidence, decisions, Responses, return measurements, and Outcomes across the systems and sites that each see only part of the story.
SSOM conformance and MQTT/Sparkplug compatibility are separate conformance domains.

The architecture separates customer operations from cross-site learning. SSOM conformance does not grant contribution rights. Purpose, consent, minimization, transformation, provenance, retention, and model scope remain explicit, and aggregate learning cannot rewrite customer canonical facts.

Infinit-Flow determines what should happen next and creates one durable Response across operators, work systems, providers, approvals, evidence, and return measurements. It executes only the digital steps policy allows and keeps physical authority where operations require it.

Choose an operational object type and intent. Infinit-Flow returns only assets compatible with the required SSOM class, capability, tenant, site, role, quality, and freshness. Simple controls appear first; expert semantic and lineage detail remains available when needed.
Retain physical-work, safety, LOTO, and control authority under customer policy.
Work-system state is contextual evidence only; it cannot set the physical result.

Infinit-Control gives each role a governed operational command surface for current state, canonical topology, evidence, ownership, work, system participation, authority, return measurements, and verified Outcomes. It is more than a dashboard because it keeps the complete accountable response in view.
Important measurements show a numerical value, engineering unit, expected or reference band, state icon and text, and meaningful trend or freshness.
Stale, quarantined, unresolved, or missing inputs are shown as No valid data and cannot support a recovered result.
A reading becomes more useful when your team knows which asset it belongs to, when it was captured, whether it can be trusted, and what needs attention.
Completing the work and restoring normal operation are two different things. Accountable Operations keeps the response connected until the operating result has been checked.
As you come online, we’ll assign named Cloud Operations engineers, your operations contacts at Last Mile.
The platform is built to report its own health to our operations team. When those checks flag an issue, we contact you directly.
Built-in chat connects your team directly with our operations team.
Expect regular, proactive conversations about how things are going, what is changing, and where you need more from us.
Our ambition is to earn the highest customer service ratings in our field.
Good Service Remembers... Great Service Anticipates.
